capabilities: Pick dates from a calendar opened next to date links
Modify an existing date link via the calendar
Insert today's date or a date link at the cursor
Configure date formats with Moment.js patterns
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual calendar for picking or modifying dates in notes, so dates must be typed manually.
summary: Date picker that opens a calendar view next to date links and inserts today's date via commands.
